title: Upstrs Master Suite 15 min fr DT Nashville NO FEES
description:
This is adult only! We have a 3 bdrm 2 bath unused upstairs. You will be renting only this room/ bath. This room is a master suite/w a twin  bed, queen bed, an over sized comfy recliner.  The bedroom has a lrg smart TV with Amazon prime movies and HULU . Has ensuite bath W  tub/ shower. Linens, towels. We have a beautiful deck/grill that you can enjoy. We  15 minute from Downtn Nashville. Coffee/tea/soda. Large kitchen which you can cook in. No curfew, come/ go as you please. NO SMOKING/Vaping.

The space
You’re welcome to use the kitchen, we have an extra refrigerator for guest use in the garage, if you need to store food. We have board games, just ask. We also have a large deck with a propane fire pit, fun lightning, a grill and seating.

Guest access
1 parking spot. We have a beautiful deck with a fire pit that you’re welcome to use. It has outdoor lighting, a gazebo with a table and chairs

During your stay
We don’t intrude on anyone’s stay. When guests are here, we try to stay as invisible as possible. The majority of the time we’re working, six days a week. However, if you need us, we’re just text message away.

Other things to note
We provide linens, pillows, soap and shampoo, Kleenex, toilet paper, hair dryer and a coffee bar.
